# Uber Eats

> Global food and beverage delivery platform connecting restaurants, retailers, and customers for on-demand ordering and same-day delivery services.

Uber Eats provides comprehensive food delivery, alcohol delivery, grocery delivery, and merchant partnership services across multiple countries including the United States and Australia. The platform supports restaurants, convenience stores like 7-Eleven and Gopuff, liquor retailers like Total Wine & More, and grocery chains including Sprouts Farmers Market and Walgreens.

## Key Topics

- Food delivery and restaurant ordering
- Same-day alcohol delivery
- Wine and spirits delivery
- Merchant partnerships and restaurant onboarding
- Convenience store delivery (7-Eleven, Gopuff, Walgreens)
- Grocery and retail delivery
- Local restaurant menus and pricing
- Customer support and help center
- SNAP/EBT payment acceptance
- Multi-city delivery coverage
- Liquor store partnerships (Total Wine, Joy Wine and Liquor)
- Australian market operations (Adelaide, Brisbane, Canberra)
- Online ordering platform
- Restaurant brand delivery networks
- Real-time order tracking
